title: Small Appliance Product Exchange Policy
text: A kitchen appliance may be exchanged for another model within 30 days when the customer provides the receipt, appliance, and all original accessories.

topic: opened used appliance condition clean damaged complete accessories
title: Opened Appliance Condition Policy
text: An opened appliance is eligible for exchange after a service-desk condition check when it is clean, undamaged, and complete with all original accessories. Damaged or incomplete products require a separate return review.

title: Exchange Price Difference Policy
text: For an approved exchange, the customer pays the difference when the replacement costs more or receives the difference when the replacement costs less.

title: Store Pickup Purchase Policy
text: A pickup purchase may be placed after the customer confirms the exact product and store. The order confirmation must repeat the product, pickup store, and order number.

topic: inventory stock available pickup reservation hold store
title: Inventory Reservation Policy
text: Displayed inventory is used to select a pickup store. Stock is only reserved after the pickup purchase is successfully placed.

title: Product Warranty Guidance Policy
text: Warranty duration comes from the selected product specification. Warranty support applies to covered product defects and is separate from the 30-day exchange process.
